match.userMessage:
A cinematic establishing shot. Opening scene: Scene 1 — 18s — Downtown Apartment Bathroom, Morning

Shot 1 — 6s

Hard morning light cuts across white tile and a black stone sink. Scarlett, a sharp-eyed city influencer in a black turtleneck, tears open a coral-colored lipstick carton with one hand while her phone vibrates beside the faucet. She ignores the phone, focused on the small ritual; handheld camera drifts closer over her shoulder.

Shot 2 — 6s

Her fingers twist the lipstick upward. The coral bullet catches a clean stripe of sunligh Art style: Modern social-first product photography with tactile, editorial energy. Products shown in real-life context -- hands opening packaging, fingers pressing textures, products on bathroom shelves, kitchen counters, rumpled linen. Close-up detail shots emphasize material and finish. Flat-lays with curated minimal arrangements. Color-matched backgrounds that complement the product. Every frame feels like something you would screenshot and save. Mood: Fresh, sensory, and effortlessly cool. Lighting: Bright natural window light with clean directional shadows. Direct on-camera flash for punchy editorial energy on select shots. No heavy diffusion -- let light feel real and immediate. Warm late-afternoon glow for lifestyle moments. High-key and airy overall with pops of contrast. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
